deals.summary: Microsoft's cumulative investment in OpenAI (2019–2023); after the 2025 restructuring it holds about 27% of OpenAI Group PBC.
OpenAI committed to buy an incremental $250B of Azure services as part of its restructuring.
SoftBank led OpenAI's $40B round, committing about $30B.
Letter of intent: Nvidia to invest up to $100B in OpenAI progressively as each gigawatt of Nvidia systems is deployed.
OpenAI to deploy at least 10 GW of Nvidia systems, first gigawatt on Vera Rubin in 2H 2026.
OpenAI to deploy 6 GW of AMD Instinct GPUs, starting with MI450 in 2H 2026.
AMD granted OpenAI warrants for up to 160M AMD shares (~10%), vesting with GPU deployment milestones.
OpenAI and Broadcom to co-develop and deploy 10 GW of custom AI accelerators, 2026–2029.
Reported five-year, ~$300B compute contract starting 2027 (Stargate capacity).
OpenAI's CoreWeave contracts total about $22.4B ($11.9B in March, $4B in May, $6.5B in September 2025).
Meta signed a ~$14.2B compute agreement with CoreWeave running to 2031.
Nvidia agreed to buy any CoreWeave cloud capacity left unsold, up to $6.3B through 2032.
Nvidia is an early CoreWeave shareholder and anchored its 2025 IPO.
Microsoft was CoreWeave's largest customer, with roughly $10B of commitments reported through 2030.
Five-year GPU cloud contract: IREN hosts Nvidia GB300 capacity for Microsoft at Childress, Texas.
IREN buys Nvidia GB300 servers from Dell for the Microsoft contract.
Five-year GPU capacity agreement from Nebius's Vineland, New Jersey site.
Five-year AI infrastructure agreement between Meta and Nebius.
Nvidia took part in Nebius's $700M private placement.
Nvidia to buy $5B of Intel stock and co-develop x86 CPUs with NVLink.
US government converted CHIPS Act grants into a ~10% Intel stake.
SoftBank bought $2B of Intel stock.
Amazon's total investment in Anthropic; AWS is Anthropic's primary training partner (Trainium).
Google's cumulative investment in Anthropic.
Anthropic to use up to one million Google TPUs, over 1 GW of capacity in 2026.
Microsoft to invest up to $5B in Anthropic.
Nvidia to invest up to $10B in Anthropic.
Anthropic committed to buy $30B of Azure compute.
Seven-year AWS agreement for Nvidia GB200/GB300 capacity.
Reported six-year Google Cloud deal for Meta.
Reported multi-year Oracle cloud deal for Meta.
Reported Oracle purchase of ~400,000 Nvidia GB200s for the Abilene, Texas Stargate site.
Oracle to deploy 50,000 AMD MI450 GPUs from 2H 2026.
Nvidia reported to invest up to $2B in xAI's funding round.
Letter of intent for SK Hynix to supply DRAM for Stargate (with Samsung, up to 900k wafers a month).
Letter of intent for Samsung to supply DRAM for Stargate.
SK Hynix is Nvidia's lead HBM supplier.
Micron supplies HBM3E for Nvidia's Blackwell GPUs.
TSMC manufactures Nvidia's GPUs and packages them with CoWoS.
TSMC manufactures AMD's Instinct GPUs and EPYC CPUs.
TSMC manufactures Broadcom's custom accelerators (Google TPU and others).
TSMC is ASML's largest customer for EUV lithography machines.
Broadcom co-designs Google's TPUs.
Five-year agreement for Marvell to supply custom AI chips (Trainium) and optics to AWS.
Twenty-year power deal restarting Three Mile Island Unit 1 (Crane Clean Energy Center).
Twenty-year deal for the output of the Clinton nuclear plant, Illinois.
Talen supplies 1.92 GW from the Susquehanna nuclear plant to AWS through 2042.
NextEra to restart the Duane Arnold nuclear plant in Iowa; Google buys the output for 25 years.
Fluidstack leases Cipher's Barber Lake site for ten years.
Google backstops $1.4B of Fluidstack's lease obligations and receives warrants for ~5.4% of Cipher.
Fluidstack leases capacity at TeraWulf's Lake Mariner campus, about $3.7B of contracted revenue.
Google backstops $3.2B of Fluidstack's obligations and takes a ~14% stake in TeraWulf.
CoreWeave leases 400 MW at Applied Digital's Polaris Forge 1 campus, North Dakota.
CoreWeave leases the full 800 MW approved at Galaxy's Helios campus, Texas.
Core Scientific hosts CoreWeave GPUs; CoreWeave's all-stock takeover bid was voted down in October 2025.
Vertiv co-develops 800 V DC power and cooling for Nvidia's next racks.
Supermicro (with Dell) built the servers for xAI's Colossus cluster.
Meta is one of Arista's two largest customers for AI cluster switching.
Google acquires power developer Intersect for $4.75B.
